text:
maria: Hey team — CI failing on SAST artifact upload after last RBAC change. Build 1234 shows "KMS: access denied" when trying to upload scan evidence to artifacts bucket. Anyone touching keystore roles?

jon: I pushed the RBAC tweak this morning (PR #453). Did I miss a service account binding?

maria: Possibly. Error in pipeline:
```
error: kms.Decrypt failed: PermissionDenied: projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/scan-artifacts: caller does not have permission
```

maria: Link to pipeline logs: https://ci.internal/1234 (redacted)

sec-bot: Alert: sdlc-scan-failure - created incident INC-2026-732

rahul: Tagging infra: @kate — we need to ensure the scanner SA (sast-runner@redwood-prod) has kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key and s3 putObject on the bucket. Also check conditional bindings from PR.

kate: Looking. I see on PR #453 you removed "serviceAccount: sast-runner@..." binding to keystore-policy. Reverting partial role, hold on.

maria: For triage: do we have a fallback to store artifacts unencrypted for 24h for oncall? CC: oncall if decrypt fails apps need a path to still ingest evidence.

jon: We didn't plan that. My vote: quick rollback of RBAC change to restore CI, then make a follow-up to formalize artifact handling.

rahul: Agreed. Also propose we add audit log enrichment: include PR id & commit SHA in artifact metadata, and emit explicit KMS access log to help postmortems.

maria: Also requesting a tiny playbook in case of KMS RBAC regressions: commands to rebind, a minimal fetch script and a rollback tag. Example:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding scan-artifacts \
  --member=serviceAccount:sast-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter\ngsutil iam ch serviceAccount:sast-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com:objectCreator gs://sast-artifacts
```

kate: Reverted the change in PR #453 and restarted pipeline. Build 1236 succeeded.

maria: Nice. Can someone open a ticket to add automated test that validates KMS IAM bindings pre-merge? Ticket: SEC-678.

jon: I'll open SEC-678 and add "k8s-sa->kms" check to our premerge CI. Also will add a detector that flags removal of keystore bindings in PR diffs.

sec-bot: Note: INC-2026-732 closed by kate (mitigated).

rahul: After SEC-678, let's discuss retention/audit requirements — maybe we need to keep artifacts decrypted logs for 90 days for audits.

maria: +1. I'll draft the mini-playbook and ping legal/compliance for retention SLAs.
